summary: This is an 8-K filed by Clene Inc. to disclose regulatory progress with the FDA regarding an accelerated approval NDA pathway for its ALS drug candidate CNM-Au8. The filing reports receipt of FDA meeting minutes indicating that proposed biomarker (neurofilament light) and clinical data may support an NDA submission under Subpart H. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation corporate event is described. The filing is a routine disclosure of a regulatory milestone and does not constitute a special situation category.
